name: prototype-review
trigger: The first screen that a prototype or a design file draws: from then on, a screen as built is compared with the screen as designed.
adds: A third fresh-context reviewer, read-only, that compares captures of a screen with the renders of its design, frame by frame and block by block.
limits: It needs the session to give it captures, design renders and the table that pairs each route with its frame: without the table it refuses to guess.
It reads images; it does not measure pixels and cannot check a behaviour that is not shown.
A reviewer laid during a session is not registered in that session: run it from the next one, or give its file to a fresh agent as its instructions.
